fit: strawberry extract and operant bar presses after 2.0 Gy irradiation
assessment: Early operant response patterns favor the strawberry diet. Comparisons at 13 and 18 months are inconclusive and irradiated controls are depleted. Primary task performance does not measure fall frequency.

fit: strawberry extract and operant response after 1.5 Gy irradiation
assessment: The author abstract reports a favorable twelve-month contrast and no six-month separation. This exposure and behavioral task do not measure Parkinson falls. Full methods and estimates remain open.

fit: strawberry or blueberry extract and conditioned taste avoidance after irradiation
assessment: Both extracts preserve learned avoidance in the amphetamine condition. Dietary groups do not separate in the lithium chloride condition. The authors measure conditioned learning rather than falls.
